method: Primary conference programs/proceedings, author PDFs, and source code. Statements here paraphrase verification findings; they are not verbatim quotations. Local artifact validation is separate.

papers.title: SCOOT: SLO-Oriented Performance Tuning for LLM Inference Engines
papers.supports: Conference identity via accepted author version and DOI; multi-knob inference tuning, constrained BO/MOBO, independent candidate evaluations.

papers.title: TuxBot: Semantic-Aware Online OS Tuning with LLMs
papers.supports: SOSP official schedule and DOI; PDF sections 4.2 and 4.5 already cover semantic trimming, numeric optimizer integration, and application-knob extension.

papers.title: LaTune: Lightweight and Adaptive Configuration Tuning for LLM Inference on Edge Devices
papers.mechanism_source: User-provided local file; publisher DOI printed in PDF
papers.supports: WWW official research-track list plus user-provided publisher PDF; sections 4.4 and 5.3 distinguish Pareto-set selection overhead from engine reconfiguration.

papers.title: Towards Dynamic and Safe Configuration Tuning for Cloud Databases
papers.supports: SIGMOD DOI and downloaded author copy; context modeling and safe online configuration exploration.

papers.title: GPTuner: A Manual-Reading Database Tuning System via GPT-Guided Bayesian Optimization
papers.supports: PVLDB official PDF, volume/number and DOI printed on page 1; knowledge-guided knob selection and coarse-to-fine BO.

papers.title: λ-Tune: Harnessing Large Language Models for Automated Database System Tuning
papers.supports: PACMMOD DOI and author version; LLM configuration generation with evaluation/reconfiguration costs.

papers.title: MorphServe: Efficient and Workload-Aware LLM Serving via Runtime Quantized Layer Swapping and KV Cache Resizing
papers.supports: MLSys official proceedings page and PDF; compared with downloaded arXiv v2 for state-preserving layer swaps and elastic KV resizing. Page numbering differs.

papers.title: Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
papers.supports: USENIX conference page and official PDF; live request migration and dynamic scheduling.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.supports: USENIX conference page and official PDF; chunked prefill and stall-free batching.

papers.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
papers.supports: USENIX conference page and official PDF; prefill/decode disaggregation and goodput-oriented planning.

papers.title: FlashInfer: Efficient and Customizable Attention Engine for LLM Inference Serving
papers.supports: MLSys official proceedings; KV representations and dynamism-aware attention execution.

papers.title: AdaServe: Accelerating Multi-SLO LLM Serving with SLO-Customized Speculative Decoding
papers.supports: EuroSys 2026 accepted list and author-hosted PDF; multi-SLO speculative decoding.

papers.title: METIS: Fast Quality-Aware RAG Systems with Configuration Adaptation
papers.supports: SOSP DOI and author-hosted final-layout PDF; joint RAG configuration and scheduling.

papers.title: Ave: Guiding Agentic GPU Optimization Using Data-Flow Invariants
papers.supports: SOSP official schedule/accepted list and DOI; author v2 describes data-flow invariants for agentic code optimization.

papers.title: OPPerTune: Post-Deployment Configuration Tuning of Services Made Easy
papers.supports: USENIX NSDI conference page and official PDF; HybridBandits and AutoScope.

papers.title: TUNA: Tuning Unstable and Noisy Cloud Applications
papers.supports: Author institution publication page identifies EuroSys 2025; PDF explains noise and unstable-configuration handling.

papers.title: QoServe: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
papers.supports: ASPLOS official program and DOI printed in author-hosted final PDF; dynamic chunking and load-adaptive priority. Niyama is an earlier name.

code_checks.observation: Measurement path creates server subprocess and finally terminates it; this alone does not establish live in-flight reconfiguration.
Resource-level evaluation entry; interpreted together with the publisher PDF, not used as evidence of all possible implementations.
Authors identify the ASPLOS artifact as the niyama_asplos2026 branch of microsoft/sarathi-serve.

interpretation_limits: Conference identity is distinct from local author-version identity.
No claim that absence from this search proves novelty.
LaTune came from user after publisher endpoint returned HTTP 403.
No GPU experiments, online controller or hot-switch implementation were run.

workload_traces.method: Repository READMEs/dataset pages and arXiv abstract pages fetched directly; Mooncake field names read from the first records of the released JSONL. Paraphrased findings, not verbatim quotations.

traces.name: Azure LLM Inference Dataset 2023
traces.supports: Production Azure LLM inference traces collected on 2023-11-11; separate code and conversation CSVs; associated paper Splitwise (ISCA 2024).

traces.name: Azure LLM Inference Dataset 2024
traces.supports: Collected 2024-05-10 to 2024-05-19 from multiple Azure LLM inference services; code and conversation CSVs; CC-BY; associated paper DynamoLLM (HPCA 2025).

traces.name: BurstGPT
traces.supports: Azure OpenAI GPT (ChatGPT/GPT-4) service traces; arXiv abstract states 10.31M traces over 213 days.

traces.name: Mooncake trace
traces.supports: Files conversation_trace.jsonl, synthetic_trace.jsonl, toolagent_trace.jsonl released in the repository; hash_ids are remapped KV block hashes usable for prefix-reuse analysis. Associated paper Mooncake (FAST 2025) confirmed on the USENIX page.

workload_traces.interpretation_limits: These traces establish that public production workloads record arrival times and length distributions (and, for Mooncake, block-level reuse). Phase-shift magnitude and its effect on optimal policy were not measured.
